title: TFC Sable Rivers
description: Makes Sable floating contraptions drift with TerraFirmaCraft river currents instead of treating rivers as still water.
body:
TFC Sable Rivers is a small compatibility mod for TerraFirmaCraft and Sable.

  It makes Sable floating contraptions react to TerraFirmaCraft river currents, allowing rafts and other floating
  structures to drift with flowing river water instead of treating it as still water.

  - Minecraft 1.21.1
  - NeoForge
  - Sable
  - TerraFirmaCraft
